evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: applying software engineering best practices such as version control, testing, and documentation to analytics
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (trusted, well-documented datasets; testing; data governance) appear throughout and no velocity phrase appears, so 'applying software engineering best practices such as version control, testing, and documentation' decides it.
evidence.domain_risk: contribute to data and analytics programs in Belgium
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A consultancy role for unnamed Belgian clients with no financial, regulatory or compliance language, so 'contribute to data and analytics programs in Belgium' points to moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: data engineers; business analysts; data scientists
evidence.data_team_maturity: Build, test, and maintain transformation logic in Microsoft Fabric
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools sit in the responsibilities ('Build, test, and maintain transformation logic in Microsoft Fabric') and the role joins client programs already on Fabric, so the data function exists and is growing.
evidence.jd_authorship: Apply best practices for data governance, security (row-level and object-level security), and capacity and cost management
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: About half the bullets are Fabric-specific ('row-level and object-level security', medallion layers, Power BI semantic models) and half are generic consultancy lines ('Support project delivery from initial design through production rollout').
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Enable business users through self-service analytics, documentation, and knowledge transfer
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The emphasis is on the semantic layer and a single source of truth for data consumers, as in 'Enable business users through self-service analytics'.
evidence.autonomy_level: You will take ownership of data transformation, modeling, and reporting workflows...Support project delivery from initial design through production rollout
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns the modelling domain ('take ownership of data transformation, modeling, and reporting workflows') while delivering client projects in a support role ('Support project delivery').
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI appears only as a perk (a GenAI workspace through a partnership) and in the company description, not as a skill the candidate must show.
evidence.testing_framing: Build, test, and maintain transformation logic in Microsoft Fabric
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is an action the candidate owns in the responsibilities ('Build, test, and maintain transformation logic') and in the role summary, not just a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: turn raw data into trusted, well-documented datasets and reports used across the organization
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust framing sits in the role summary ('trusted, well-documented datasets', 'a form they can rely on'), reflecting a fear of unreliable data reaching business users.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: You will design and build the semantic layer and analytical data models on Microsoft Fabric
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Design and build verbs dominate ('design and build the semantic layer', 'Design curated data layers'), with maintenance and improvement secondary.
evidence.language_gate: Languages: Fluent in (French or Dutch) and English (spoken and written)
